proposed_widenings.name: substitute_weapon_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants an optional on-hit rider that changes the damage type of this weapon's normal hit from its printed type to lightning without adding damage or replacing the whole attack procedure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: thrown_weapon_transforms_and_returns
proposed_widenings.justification: The Lightning Bolt property replaces the normal thrown-weapon attack with a save-gated line effect, then deterministically returns the same weapon to the wielder's hand. The current surface can model the save/damage, but not the weapon's temporary transformation into a bolt plus its automatic return as part of the same activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning... Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: MagicItemRecord and composite passive-plus-activation structure exist, but the unit cannot be encoded honestly with the current atom vocabulary. A partial activation-only trace would omit one of the item's two main mechanics.
